summary: RG-7 Core producer completed in AlembicCore commit a156e0d796d396e02d815ca22147c83d59bf880b. Added an additive per-recipe freshness primitive: SourceRefReconciler.reconcileRecipeSourceRefs() refreshes only one affected recipe's recipe_source_refs, including dropped-ref cleanup, and RecipeFreshnessService coordinates source_refs refresh with VectorService.getAvailability(), syncEntry(), and syncRecipeSemanticRegions(). Public surface is exposed through @alembic/core/knowledge with smoke coverage. No AlembicPlugin files were edited.
evidenceRefs: public-api:@alembic/core/knowledge exports RecipeFreshnessService and RecipeFreshness* result/deps/vector types
source-ref-behavior:single-recipe refresh inserts active refs, marks stale refs, removes dropped refs only for that recipe, and leaves other recipe rows untouched
vector-behavior:RecipeFreshnessService checks VectorService.getAvailability before syncEntry/syncRecipeSemanticRegions and reports degraded availability without silent success
